question: Which of the following is performed by women during the Sikkim weddings?
solution:
The correct answer is __**Maruni**__.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] **__Key Points__**

• **Maruni Dance:** **Maruni** is one of the oldest traditional dances performed during festivals and weddings in Sikkim.

• It is primarily performed by **women**, though men occasionally join in, adorned in colorful costumes and elaborate jewelry.

• This dance is accompanied by traditional Nepali music, showcasing the rich **cultural heritage** of the Nepali-speaking community in Sikkim.

• The performers often wear **bright and vibrant attire**, including long skirts, blouses, and decorative accessories, representing the joy and celebration of weddings.
